description: Config for the Renovate GitHub App. Grouping is driven by what breaks together, and CI runs the checks each pull request needs.

packageRules.description: Next and React move together. Bumping one without the other is how you get a build that only fails in the app, not in the tests.
The MCP surface. A major here changes how tools are registered, so it needs approval and the handshake check that CI runs (scripts/mcp-smoke.ts).
Type packages that nothing else is pinned to.
@types/bun tracks the runtime, so it is reviewed on its own rather than with the other type packages.
